summary: Build RBM skills for public sector and NGOs with logframes, indicators, dashboards, and reporting tools. Enroll to improve results accountability.
lede: Results-based management links program activities to outcomes and impact through a measurable results chain. For professionals in public agencies and NGOs who work with programs, indicators, reports, or performance data, the training covers building results frameworks, defining SMART indicators and baselines, and planning monitoring systems. It also addresses dashboard layouts, evaluation design, and using evidence to prepare results reports and inform decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with programs, reports, indicators, or performance data and need a stronger RBM practice. It is especially relevant if you support public accountability, donor reporting, or strategic planning in ministries, agencies, NGOs, or development partnerships.
prerequisites: You need a laptop, a current program or project document, and basic familiarity with indicators, reports, or results frameworks. If you bring a logframe, monitoring template, or recent performance report, you can apply the exercises directly to your own work.
